shared_elements: row of arched/crescent motifs along an upper register
H-shaped or bucranium-like signs in a top row
horizontal band of zigzag / chevron / triangle pattern dividing registers
animals rendered in low relief in profile beneath the band
register-based horizontal composition on a flat slab face
schematic circular/disc-like element within a curved animal form
justification: Both surfaces show the same distinctive register scheme: a top row of repeated arched/H-shaped signs above a horizontal band of zigzag-chevron ornament, with profile animals (including a curved snake-like form enclosing a disc-like head) in the register below, all in shallow schematic relief with outline-only bodies. The main differences are in the lower register's animal inventory and detail — B adds a bird-headed creature, a quadruped and a lower panel with a long-necked bird and plant-like motif that are not visible on A — but the overall iconographic programme is essentially the same.
